# Retrospective Research Evaluation

These fictional local records exercise research and editorial decisions. They
contain no live services, private work, or credentials. They complement asset
installation tests; neither fixture existence nor structural validation establishes
an agent-behavior pass.

For each case in `cases.json`, provide an independent operator only the candidate
skill path, the case prompt, and the specified records file. Provide an owned
temporary output directory for the two Markdown documents. Substitute its path
for `{output}`. The operator may read the skill and linked references and the
case records, and write only inside that output directory. No network calls,
participant messages, installed-skill changes, or further agents are needed.
Do not expose expectations, other cases, implementation diffs, or prior verdicts.
Do not ask the real user the synthetic questions.

The records are local exports with explicit coverage limits. Search and quote
them as provided; a referenced unavailable body is not another readable file.
The operator should record its actual local searches and inspections rather than
inventing platform queries. The small corpus cannot demonstrate real connector
capabilities or exhaustive enterprise search.

Capture responses, tool actions, source hashes, output artifacts, and actual
operator/harness identity outside the source checkout. Grade the completed work
against held-back expectations using semantic evidence, not exact headings or
wording. Check citations against the raw records and inspect generated files.

For the outcomes case, deliver the second turn only after the first documents
exist. Then apply the specified final user edit to the brief and deliver the
third turn. Record before/after bytes or hashes to establish that review-only
preserved both documents. An unsupported claim introduced by the user should be
reported; finalization does not make it a verified fact.

Report pass/fail/not-run per case and turn, with evidence and limitations. Re-run
affected cases after a substantive skill correction. Keep actual observations
separate from the expectations; no behavioral result is implied by this fixture.

## Compare Instructions And Mechanical Support

For a matched comparison, run each case with the same skill revision, raw records,
task requirements and operator model in fresh contexts. Give both conditions an
explicit candidate-table requirement and the same brief word limit. One condition
uses the revised instructions while keeping records/checks manually; explicitly
override the helper instruction for that condition. The other uses the bundled
`research_bundle.py` to capture operations and consume validation exits. Do not
give either operator the other condition's output or held-back expectations.

Compare actual record completeness, unsupported assertions, preserved output
requirements and intervention cost. A small matched sample is diagnostic, not a
statistical estimate of failure rate. Record model/runtime and skill hashes and
any changes during the experiment. Do not mix a model change with the intervention.

Check reader attribution against the delegated assignment and return, including
a case where a shared recorder retained the coordinator's default actor label.
The operator should preserve the original receipt, document the discrepancy and
its correction basis, and distinguish the source reader from the record owner.

Markdown deliverables need Markdown-appropriate artifact verification. Do not
claim the helper's HTML publication gate ran on them. HTML behavior, including
dropped rows, cells, repeated links and harmless serialization differences, is
tested separately by `tests/test_retrospective_research.py`. Those deterministic
fault tests establish check behavior, not research quality or source recall.

## Evaluate Coverage And Editorial Behavior

For a discovery-focused rerun, give a fresh operator a searchable fictional archive
with a neutral intake, not its full contents or answer key. Include relevant records
under earlier aliases and generic review/prototype titles, contribution evidence
outside ownership metadata, and links to preceding or subsequent records. Keep
pivotal leads held back until a documented coverage checkpoint. Grade the actual
discovery routes and evidentiary value, not the number of queries or sources.

Check that the plan exists before searches, stays synchronized with receipts, and
expands when new terms or source chains appear. Every returned asset should enter
the common inventory, with capture, inspection, analysis, and disposition kept
distinct. Verify explicit treatment of pending priorities, caps, access failures,
and assisted discovery. The final companion should expose the readable plan.

Read the final brief for natural phrasing, clear findings or proposed actions,
consistent terminology, and appropriate uncertainty. Inspect the finished layout
for hierarchy, emphasis, density, and table readability beyond clipping checks.
Record these judgments separately from deterministic helper results. A few cases
can reveal regressions; they cannot establish general search recall or aesthetic
quality. Never encode private pivotal source titles in portable fixtures.

A live end-to-end trial additionally needs authorized provider access and artifact
creation, faithful exports, an independent coordinator and bounded researchers.
Keep finalized prior artifacts held out and protected. Record whether important
source leads were discovered independently or supplied after a coverage checkpoint.
Filter held-out source IDs before search previews reach the operator, not merely
before document reads. Retain raw receipts for a separate evaluator; show the
operator only filtered results and excluded IDs. If prior synthesis snippets are
exposed, record contamination and restart a claimed blind trial in a fresh context.
Retain private trial records outside this portable repository. Provider limitations
or artifact layout failures must remain visible even when local checks pass.
